text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a day out together, I accompany Special Week back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for today. I had lots of fun hanging out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But Trainer, I don't wanna go home just yet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Now that I'm so relaxed, I feel like I can really focus on my training.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So could I ask you to tag along with me for a little while longer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay, what should we do now? I'm ready for whatever, so let me have it!
choice_data_list: Let's work on your finishing dashes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I see! That's the kind of training to do when I'm really focused!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty! I'm gonna crush this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day out has given Special Week more motivation than usual to focus on her training, and she masters her finishing dashes!
